carters.name: The Carters' Guild
carters.desc: Pleased by a Trade Depot, a second quay and every open trade route; displeased by a city without a depot and by congested roads.
carters.boon: depots sell half again as much surplus each day
carters.strike: the yards work slow: depots sell half as much
carters.petition: The carters crowd the Guildhall steps with their caps in their hands. Their master says the markets run dry while his carts stand idle, and asks the Warden-Reeve to let the guild buy from the Gloam road.

alchemists.name: The Alchemists' Guild
alchemists.desc: Pleased by five or more Craft yards and by the Herb Garden Edict; displeased when markets run dry of their goods.
alchemists.strike: the stills run cold: Craft yards make 10% less
alchemists.petition: The alchemists send a letter sealed in blue wax. Every yard in the city, they write, should keep a glimherb bed by law, miasma or no miasma, and they would like the Warden-Reeve to say so.

spirewrights.name: The Spire-Wrights
spirewrights.desc: Pleased by a Ley Nexus and by Spire Wardens; displeased by every day of overdraw and by brownouts.
spirewrights.boon: ley stores hold a fifth more mana
spirewrights.strike: ley stores leak: a fifth less mana held
spirewrights.petition: The spire-wrights come at dusk, as they do. The spires have been run hot, they say, and nobody watches them at night. They ask for Tallowkin wardens on the city purse.

sextons.name: The Sextons of Morrow
sextons.desc: Pleased by an Ossuary and by the Rite Subsidy; displeased when more than twenty dead lie unquieted.
sextons.boon: boneyards and ossuaries quiet 15% more dead
sextons.strike: the sextons work to rule: deathcare quiets 15% fewer
sextons.petition: Hollis of the sextons stands in the Guildhall with his spoon of salt and says nothing for a long time. Then he says the city should pay for the rites it expects, and that the dead are counting.
